chunks.arabic_text: أَبُو عَلِيٍّ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْجُنَيْدِ الْكَاتِبُ الْإِسْكَافِيُّ.

translations.en: Abu 'Ali Muhammad ibn al-Junayd, the scribe, al-Iskafi.
translations.ur: ابو علی محمد بن الجنید، کاتب، الاسکافی۔
translations.tr: Ebu Ali Muhammed ibn el-Cüneyd, kâtip, el-İskâfî.
translations.fa: ابوعلی محمد بن الجنید، کاتب، الاسکافی.
translations.id: Abu 'Ali Muhammad ibn al-Junayd, sang penulis, al-Iskafi.
translations.bn: আবু আলী মুহাম্মদ ইবন আল-জুনাইদ, লেখক, আল-ইস্কাফি।
translations.es: Abu 'Ali Muhammad ibn al-Junayd, el escriba, al-Iskafi.
translations.fr: Abu 'Ali Muhammad ibn al-Junayd, le scribe, al-Iskafi.
translations.de: Abu 'Ali Muhammad ibn al-Junayd, der Schreiber, al-Iskafi.
translations.ru: Абу ‘Али Мухаммад ибн аль-Джунайд, писец, аль-Искафи.
translations.zh: 阿布·阿里·穆罕默德·伊本·朱奈德，书记员，阿尔-伊斯卡菲。

key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: The second part of the kunyah, completing the name Abu 'Ali.
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ: The personal name of the individual identified in the entry.
key_terms.الْجُنَيْدِ: His family name or lineage designation: ibn al-Junayd.
key_terms.الْكَاتِبُ: A professional or descriptive epithet meaning 'the scribe.'
key_terms.الْإِسْكَافِيُّ: A nisbah indicating attribution to al-Iskaf.
